title: Plant Manager
text:
The Plant Manager will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, developing high-performing teams, improving plant efficiency, and delivering exceptional service to customers. This position partners closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams including Quality, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, R&D, and Sales to achieve strategic business objectives.

**Client Details**

An established and growing food manufacturing company is seeking an experienced Plant Manager to lead all site operations for its Midwest production facility. Reporting to senior operations leadership, this role will oversee manufacturing, warehousing, maintenance, facilities, food safety, quality, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Description**

* Lead all day-to-day manufacturing, warehouse, maintenance, sanitation, and facilities operations.
* Drive productivity, efficiency, quality, safety, and cost-reduction initiatives across the plant.
* Develop and manage operating and capital budgets aligned with company growth objectives.
* Ensure production schedules are executed efficiently while meeting customer requirements and service expectations.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives through process optimization, waste reduction, and operational excellence programs.
* Partner with Quality and Food Safety teams to maintain regulatory compliance and successfully achieve customer, regulatory, and third-party audit requirements.
* Analyze production and operational data to identify opportunities for improved performance and profitability.
* Oversee capital projects, equipment upgrades, and implementation of new manufacturing technologies.
* Build, mentor, and develop leadership teams while driving employee engagement and accountability.
* Collaborate with Finance to achieve financial targets and monitor plant performance metrics.
* Partner with HR on workforce planning, employee development, safety programs, and compliance initiatives.
* Serve as a key member of the site leadership team, contributing to both tactical execution and long-term business strategy.

MPI encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. the company will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance

**Profile**

A successful Plant Manager should have:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant industry experience.
* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in food manufacturing operations, including responsibility for plant performance, people leadership, and budget management.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing operations, continuous improvement, strategic planning, financial management, and team development.
* Experience leading operations in a fast-paced food manufacturing environment with demanding quality and service standards.
* Demonstrated ability to manage changing priorities, solve complex operational challenges, and drive results in a dynamic production setting.
* Proven success building high-performing teams and fostering a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Strong operational and financial acumen.
* Leadership experience in food manufacturing, CPG, ingredients, bakery, beverage, frozen foods, or related sectors.
* A hands-on, collaborative management style.
* Passion for developing people and driving operational excellence.

**Job Offer**

* Permanent Plant Manager position.
* Salary of $140,000 to $180,000.
* 401(k) match.
* PTO.
* Medical benefits.
